answer: A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the fable queue naming the haven that holds the sponsor's bond. As a result, every alias costs 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the inlet record shows exactly who is still on probation. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
